discoveries.name: The wildflower meadow
discoveries.hint: about 36 steps east of the plaza
discoveries.finding: Seven kinds of flower grow here in bands by soil. The bees visit the yellow band first, in the cool of the morning.

discoveries.name: The old boundary stone
discoveries.hint: about 44 steps north-west of the plaza
discoveries.finding: A worn stone, older than the village. Its lichen grows only on the north face, so it also tells you which way you face.

discoveries.name: The hidden spring
discoveries.hint: about 49 steps north-east of the plaza
discoveries.finding: Cold, clear water rises here all year. It feeds the well by an underground seam: the well is never really empty.

discoveries.name: The high view
discoveries.hint: about 52 steps north of the plaza
discoveries.finding: From here the whole valley is a map: fields, the winding road, and where the next cottages could stand.

discoveries.name: The bee hollow
discoveries.hint: about 46 steps north of the plaza
discoveries.finding: A hollow oak hums with a colony. Keepers note the bees are calm unless smoke is near; the honey feeds the whole village.

discoveries.name: The lichen wall
discoveries.hint: about 44 steps west of the plaza
discoveries.finding: Lichen draws a slow map on the stone. Researchers measure its growth each season; the clean air shows in its colours.

discoveries.name: The birdsong grove
discoveries.hint: about 60 steps north-west of the plaza
discoveries.finding: At dawn eleven species sing in turn. Scholars are keeping a score of the chorus, one new voice a week.

discoveries.name: The clay bank
discoveries.hint: about 30 steps north-east of the plaza
discoveries.finding: Fine red clay, good for bricks and pots. Makers dig only what they need and smooth the bank behind them.

discoveries.name: The star meadow
discoveries.hint: about 46 steps south-east of the plaza
discoveries.finding: The darkest corner of Harr. On clear nights the observatory scholars chart the sky from here before the platform is done.

discoveries.name: The wind ridge
discoveries.hint: about 35 steps south of the plaza
discoveries.finding: A steady breeze crosses this ridge. A small mill here could turn grain for the whole village; the plans are in the library.
